results.summary: Gradle, JS: `--continuous ` mode doesn't update js file in `distributions` folder with  `jsBrowserDevelopmentWebpack`
results.description:
Consider the following project layout

<details>

`build.gradle.kts`:
```kotlin
plugins {
    kotlin("multiplatform") version "1.4-M3"
}

repositories {
    mavenCentral()
    jcenter()
    maven { url = uri("https://dl.bintray.com/kotlin/kotlin-eap") }
}

kotlin {
    js {
        useCommonJs()
        browser {}
        binaries.executable()
    }
    sourceSets {
        val jsMain by getting {
            dependencies {
                implementation(kotlin("stdlib-js"))
            }
        }
    }
}
```
`settings.gradle.kts`:
```kotlin
pluginManagement {
    repositories {
        mavenCentral()
        gradlePluginPortal()
        maven { url = uri("https://dl.bintray.com/kotlin/kotlin-eap") }
    }
}
rootProject.name = "projectName"
```
`src/jsMain/kotlin/Main.kt`:
```kotlin
fun main() {
    println("Hello world.")
}
```
</details>

1) Build the project normally once with `./gradlew jsBrowserDevelopmentWebpack`.
2) Run `./gradlew jsBrowserDevelopmentWebpack --continuous` to start a watch. Wait for the `Waiting for changes to input files of tasks...` message. Change the contents of `src/jsMain/kotlin/Main.kt` (for example, add `FOOBAR` to the end of the `Hello world.` string).
You will see the project rebuilding itself with output along the lines of


results.summary: Replace KotlinPackageJsonTask as the source of shared npm project package.json files
results.description: In KT-89214, two new consumable configurations were introduced, `kotlinNpmSharedPackageJsonFiles` and `kotlinWasmNpmSharedPackageJsonFiles`, to which each registered subproject adds its `package.json` collected from `compilation.npmProject.packageJsonFile`, the output of `KotlinPackageJsonTask`. That task depends on the root-project npm resolver: tooling `devDependencies` (karma, mocha, webpack, playwright) only appear when the root `rootPackageJson` task is configured, so `kotlinSetupSharedNpmProject` alone produces test `package.json` files without them, and transitive dependencies are collected by reading other projects' models, which is not Isolated Projects compatible. Implement an alternative approach to collect the npm dependencies of subprojects.

results.summary: Missing dependency between jsProductionExecutableCompileSync and jsBrowserProductionRun
results.description:

Reason: Task ':client:jsBrowserProductionRun' uses this output of task ':client:jsProductionExecutableCompileSync' without declaring an explicit or implicit dependency. This can lead to incorrect results being produced, depending on what order the tasks are executed. Please refer to https://docs.gradle.org/7.4.2/userguide/validation_problems.html#implicit_dependency for more details about this problem.

If I add the dependency manually to my `build.gradle.kts` file, the warning will go away.

```
kotlin {

        val browserProductionRun = tasks.named("jsBrowserProductionRun").get()
```

results.summary: Gradle, JS: Ability to persist / reuse yarn.lock
results.description:
Currently when using Kotlin/JS Gradle plugin:
```
plugins {
  kotlin("js") version "1.3.50"
}
```
`yarn.lock` file is being placed in `build/js` directory and thus recreated each time npm dependencies are installed.

Typically `yarn.lock` should be persisted (committed) in order to lock dependency tree. Are there any options to persist it?

results.summary: Kotlin/JS Playwright browser tests race with shared cache
results.description:
**Bug Description**
Kotlin/JS Playwright browser tests can intermittently fail snapshotting shared cache when installers run in parallel.

**Reproduction Steps**
Steps and/or the code snippet to reproduce the behavior:
1. Configure multiple Kotlin/JS subprojects with Kotlin Gradle plugin 2.4.21 and the new `browser { test { chromium() } }` DSL.
2. Enable Gradle parallel execution and run their browser tests together. KGP registers a `kotlinInstallPlaywrightBrowsers` task in each subproject; the installers share the same Playwright browser cache.
3. A browser-test task can become ready after its own installer finishes while another subproject's installer is still using the shared cache.
```text
Cannot access input property 'testFrameworkInputs$kotlin_gradle_plugin_common.playwrightBrowsersDirectory'.
java.nio.file.NoSuchFileException: /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/__dirlock
```
